superMarkdown.configuration.preview.them: Follow the current VS Code color theme.
Use a low-saturation green background for long reading.
Use a warm paper-like reading background.
Use a soft black night-reading background.
Use a clean blue-tinted reading background.
superMarkdown.configuration.preview.font: Base font size for the preview in pixels.
superMarkdown.configuration.preview.maxW: Maximum content width for the preview in pixels.
superMarkdown.configuration.toc.levels.d: Heading levels included in the outline and generated table of contents.
superMarkdown.configuration.organize.upd: Update the Super Markdown table of contents when saving Markdown files.
superMarkdown.configuration.organize.num: Add or update H2-H6 section numbering when organizing Markdown.
superMarkdown.configuration.mermaid.enab: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks in the preview.
superMarkdown.configuration.katex.enable: Render KaTeX math in the preview.
superMarkdown.configuration.displayLangu: Display language for Super Markdown UI. Command titles contributed to VS Code still follow VS Code's display language.
Use Simplified Chinese for Super Markdown UI.
Use English for Super Markdown UI.
